disposition_reason: WHO FAS 64 (JECFA 73) cadmium addendum reports cocoa only inside combined 'coffee, tea & cocoa' categories (no cocoa-specific Cd numbers), but the lead addendum in the same volume prints Singapore 2008 Pb data for cocoa products (n=206, mean 0.692 mg/kg, max 45.4) and cocoa butter (n=34, all <LOD), with three named high cocoa powder values.

study.design: monitoring summary (JECFA monograph, cadmium and lead addenda)
study.material_scope: cocoa products except cocoa butter; cocoa butter (Pb, Singapore)
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Singapore market samples; growing origin not reported

findings.material: Cocoa products except for cocoa butter
findings.censoring: 44 of 206 <LOD (LOD 0.09 mg/kg); substitution for the mean not stated
findings.locator: Lead addendum, Section 6.5 Singapore and Table 9 (p. 444-445 of WHO FAS 64)
findings.notes: Singapore national data submitted to JECFA 73 (lead addendum); 437 samples of 1009 collected in 2008 analysed for Pb; method not reported; LOD 0.09 mg/kg, LOQ 0.3 mg/kg; 57% of all samples <LOD. Treatment of <LOD in the mean not stated. Repeated in Table 25 (p. 476) as "Cocoa & chocolate & products" n=206, weighted mean 0.692, range of national means "<LOD-0.69", max 45.4 (Singapore-only data). Category mixes cocoa products (incl. cocoa powder) and possibly chocolate; product mix not specified.

exposure.statement: JECFA 73 established a PTMI for cadmium (replacing the PTWI of 7 µg/kg bw, which was withdrawn).
exposure.locator: Cadmium addendum, Section 10 (text near line of 'PTMI established was 25 µg/kg bw')

exposure.statement: JECFA 73 withdrew the lead PTWI of 25 µg/kg bw as no longer health protective.
Cocoa products listed among foods with the highest frequency of detectable lead (with shellfish, organ meats etc.).
exposure.locator: Lead addendum, Section 9.7-9.8 text, pp. 461 and 475

exposure.statement: Cadmium: EFSA-derived exposure contribution for 'Coffee, tea, cocoa' (0.002 mg/kg as liquid x 601 g/day) = 1.1 µg/day; cocoa not separated.

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Stored summary records only 'Coffee, tea, cocoa 1.1' exposure and contains no cocoa occurrence data; it omits the Singapore cocoa lead data (mean 0.692 mg/kg, max 45.4 mg/kg; three cocoa powder samples 45.4, 35.4, 25.3 mg/kg) printed in the lead addendum of the same volume.
unresolved: Cadmium cocoa data in this volume are only combined coffee/tea/cocoa categories (e.g. food industry aggregated raw materials 2002-2009: coffee, tea & cocoa mean 1.75 mg/kg 'particularly the latter', n=1284, max 1327 mg/kg) - cocoa share not extractable.

The lead findings sit in the lead addendum of this WHO FAS 64 volume; the source_id names cadmium. Parent should decide whether lead rows belong to this source record or a separate jecfa-73rd-lead record.
Singapore <LOD handling in the mean not stated; product composition of 'cocoa products except cocoa butter' not given.
Table 25 range '<LOD-0.69' for 'Cocoa & chocolate & products' is inconsistent with a single-country (Singapore) dataset; not resolvable.
